subject: gse/sgp-chain-wired
body: SGP chain is now wired end to end: estimator -> copula engine -> price. price_from_measured_correlations.py feeds the MEASURED matrix into sgp_copula_engine.price_sgp (which had 26 tests and had never been handed data). 4-leg parlay: independent 0.0306 vs true joint 0.1178, z=+60.48, lift +284.61%. Also added cross-side block (all coefficients POSITIVE -- shootout, not clock suppression; sign is not guessable) and the joint 8x8 (PSD, min eig 0.2511). Guard: leg-order assert, because a silent reorder yields a plausible meaningless price. Still open: marginals are illustrative, no SGP price ingested. Tests: props 59, sgp 32, physics 19, free-auto-settle 28, refresh-cycle 16. Branch fix/galaxy-odds-first-2026-10-08 pushed through 9418a046b.
